temporal_composition.anticipation_phase: Energy buildup before the main event. Duration: 100-400ms. Visual: converging particles, brightening glow, screen shake, charging particles, contracting energy. Purpose: tells player/viewer WHERE and WHEN impact will occur.
temporal_composition.birth_phase: The instant of impact. Duration: 1-3 frames. Visual: brightest flash, maximum particle density, sharp contrast against background. Purpose: peak visual punctuation — this is the screenshot moment.
temporal_composition.primary_event: The main visual read. Duration: 200-600ms. Visual: expanding shockwave, debris/sparks burst, energy ring, directional particle spray. This is what the viewer remembers.
temporal_composition.secondary_event: Follow-up elements. Duration: 400-1000ms. Visual: trailing sparks, secondary debris, smoke puffs, lingering glow, afterimage. Gives the event depth and complexity.
temporal_composition.tertiary_detail: Fine elements that reward close inspection. Duration: 500-2000ms. Visual: tiny embers, dust motes, light refraction artifacts, subtle ground scorch, heat shimmer. Separates professional VFX from basic.
temporal_composition.dissipation: The event fades out. Duration: 500-3000ms. Visual: particles fade/shrink, smoke dissipates, glow dims, debris settles, scorch marks remain. Must not just disappear — needs transition to rest state.

physical_debris.primary_shapes: Angular fragments, irregular chunks, directional spray from impact point
physical_debris.motion: Gravity-influenced arcs, bounce on ground contact, secondary collision particles
physical_debris.color: Scene-material-derived (concrete = gray, metal = warm gray, earth = brown)
physical_debris.value: Wide range — bright flash at birth, dark debris in flight, midtone settled debris
physical_debris.timing: Fast birth (1-2 frames flash), rapid primary spray (200ms), longer debris arcs (500-1000ms), slow dust settle (2000ms+)

magical_energy.primary_shapes: Flowing ribbons, orbital particles, radial bursts, runic/symbolic shapes
magical_energy.motion: Gravity-defying arcs, spiral trails, floating particle drift, oscillating intensity
magical_energy.color: Saturated spectral colors (violet/cyan/magenta/gold), deliberate color harmony
magical_energy.value: Bright at core, darker at edges. Emissive glow reads against dark backgrounds
magical_energy.timing: Anticipation glow (200-400ms), explosive radial burst (100-300ms), lingering particle drift (1000-3000ms)
magical_energy.energy_shape: Radial + spiral, often with symbolic concentric rings

technological_signal.primary_shapes: Scanlines, data streams, hexagonal grids, concentric rings, wireframe overlays
technological_signal.motion: Linear propagation, scanning sweeps, grid expansion, data cascade, clean directional flow
technological_signal.color: Signal colors (cyan, amber, green on dark), high contrast, limited palette
technological_signal.value: Binary — bright signal lines on dark/transparent background. Few midtones.
technological_signal.timing: Scanning buildup (200-300ms), grid pulse (100-200ms), data cascade fade (500-1500ms)
technological_signal.energy_shape: Planar/2D-aligned grids, holographic projection cones, concentric data rings

diagnostic_framework.particle_spam: Too many particles with uniform size/brightness/speed. No hierarchy — everything fights for attention. Fix: reduce count, create size/speed hierarchy, use fewer but more deliberate elements.
diagnostic_framework.constant_intensity: The VFX maintains the same brightness throughout its lifecycle. No birth flash, no dissipation fade. Looks like a looping GIF. Fix: add alpha/size curve that peaks early and decays.
diagnostic_framework.no_dissipation: Particles disappear instantly or persist forever. Unnatural, jarring. Fix: add fade-out with slight size reduction and speed decay.
diagnostic_framework.zero_environment_interaction: VFX exists in isolation — no ground contact, no reflection on nearby surfaces, no shadow. Looks composited, not integrated. Fix: add ground plane interaction (decal/scorch), light contribution to scene.
diagnostic_framework.gameplay_obscuring: VFX blocks the player's view of important gameplay elements. Screen-space occupancy is too high. Fix: reduce opacity, move effects to periphery, use negative space in effect design.
diagnostic_framework.overdraw_catastrophe: Too many overlapping transparent particles causing GPU fill-rate issues. Fix: reduce particle count, use opaque particles where possible, limit screen coverage.

niagara_mapping.simulation_stages: Modules execute in ordered groups within each frame
niagara_mapping.key_workflow: Define emitter → configure spawn rate/distribution → add force/velocity modules → define particle update (color/size/rotation over lifetime) → configure renderer
